text.en: Creation of Barangays Acmac-Mariano Badelles Sr., San Roque, Luinab, Upper Hinaplanon, and Ubaldo Laya. — There shall be created five (5) barangays in the City of Iligan to be known as Barangay Acmac-Mariano Badelles Sr., Barangay San Roque, Barangay Luinab, Barangay Upper Hinaplanon, and Barangay Ubaldo Laya.

Conduct and Supervision of Plebiscite. — The plebiscite conducted and supervised by the Commission on Elections pursuant to Iligan City Ordinance Numbered 1934 dated February 5, 1991 for the creation of Barangay Luinab, 1945 dated March 20, 1991 for the creation of Barangay Upper Hinaplanon, 1931, 1932 and 1946 all dated duly 22, 1991 for the creation of Barangay Acmac-Mariano Badelles Sr., Barangay San Roque and Barangay Ubaldo Laya respectively, which ratified the creation of said barangays as proclaimed by the Plebiscite Board of Canvassers shall serve as substantial compliance with the plebiscite requirement under Section 10 of Republic Act No. 7160, otherwise known as the Local Government Code of 1991, as amended.

Incumbent Barangay Officials. — The incumbent barangay officials of Barangays Acmac-Mariano Badelles Sr., San Roque, Luinab, Upper Hinaplanon, and Ubaldo Laya shall continue to hold office until such time that their successors have been duly elected and qualified.

Public Infrastructure and Facilities. — All existing public infrastructure and facilities for public use within the territorial boundaries of the newly-created barangays shall continue to be owned and administered by them.

Internal Revenue Allotment (IRA) Shares. — Barangays Acmac-Mariano Badelles Sr., San Roque, Luinab, Upper Hinaplanon, and Ubaldo Laya shall be entitled to Internal Revenue Allotment (IRA) shares pursuant to Section 285 of Republic Act No. 7160, otherwise known as the Local Government Code of 1991, as amended.
Repealing Clause. — All laws, decrees, executive orders, rules and regulations contrary to or inconsistent with any provision of this Act are hereby repealed or amended accordingly.
Effectivity. — This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
